paper_title: Stochastic fluctuations of bosonic dark matter
notes: This is a methodological/theoretical paper showing that constraints from VULF dark matter searches in the T<<tau_c regime are overestimated by factors ~3-10 due to neglecting stochastic field amplitude fluctuations. It re-derives correction factors and rescales previously published limits (CASPEr-ZULF, nEDM, dilaton clock searches) rather than presenting a new original measurement. The exclusion plots (Figs 3,4) show corrected versions of existing constraints for axion-nucleon coupling g_aNN and dilaton couplings, but these are not new measured limits and no readable numerical data points are provided.
